m.t: Ha declarado que conoce a mi cliente desde hace tiempo.
m.e: You testified you've known my client for some time.

m.e: As a result, the Clave has declared a state of emergency at the Institute.

m.e: And yet, your client just pleaded to sexual deviance.

m.t: Aprender los pasos no quita la pasión, la aumenta.
